mapper.select: SELECT tc.id, tc.event_name AS eventName, CASE WHEN tc.todo_type = '用药计划' THEN 'medication' WHEN tc.todo_type = '日常安排' THEN 'schedule' END AS todoType, sm.dosage, tc.start_time AS startTime, CASE WHEN tc.todo_type = '用药计划' THEN tc.start_time WHEN tc.todo_type = '日常安排' THEN sd.end_time END AS endTime, tc.start_date AS startDate, tc.end_date AS endDate, sd.location, sd.remarks, tc.completed FROM todo_calendar tc LEFT JOIN schedule_medication sm ON tc.id = sm.todo_id LEFT JOIN schedule_daily sd ON tc.id = sd.todo_id WHERE tc.user_id = #{userId} AND tc.start_date = #{date}
